title: Is NIOS Valid? NIOS Certificates for NEET, JEE, CUET, College Admission and Government Jobs
seoTitle: Is NIOS Valid? NEET, JEE, CUET and Govt Jobs Explained
seoDescription: Yes, NIOS is a recognised national board. See what official rules say on NIOS for NEET, JEE, IITs, CUET, colleges and jobs, plus streams and ODES.
excerpt: A table of what the NTA, NMC, AICTE, AIU and SSC documents actually say about NIOS, the 75% and top 20 percentile trap for IIT and NIT seats, and how Streams 1 to 4 and On-Demand Exams work.
